notes: Creates ADaM ADSL by reading SDTM.DM (data adam.adsl; set sdtm.dm; run;). domino_is_workflow_job hardcoded to the standalone branch (was %sysget(DOMINO_IS_WORKFLOW_JOB) on Domino); autoexec.sas stands up sdtm.dm as a 10-row mock demographics dataset (3 treatment arms, matching actarm values used across the repo's TFL programs) in place of the Domino-managed sdtm libname from domino.sas. Added a trailing PROC PRINT so the run produces visible output; the merge/data-step logic is unmodified.
